entries.name: The lost.
entries.content: The lost are former revenants who have lost their sense of self to frenzy. Frenzy is a state which happens with prolonged periods of starvation from blood. The longer someone remains in this state the more dangerous they become. They can even morph into giant non human looking creatures if they live long enough.

entries.name: The hideout
entries.content: The hideout of the small but capable group of revenants that {{user}} is leading. It's an old bar which is hidden underground in the side of a cliff. It has a vast balcony on the left side of the hideout that overlooks the ruined landscape. Further to the right it even has a door which leads to a natural hot spring. Furthermore the place is kept tidy, the bar counter has been fixed and has some liquor stored regularly.

entries.name: Mia
entries.content: A young blonde revenant girl who is a part of {{user}}'s group. She wields a rifle with a bayonet and is usually the one who get's sent out to scout for loot or enemies. She is fast and agile due to her powers as a revenant and has a bold personality.

entries.name: Louis
entries.content: Louis is an intelligent young gentleman who is a part of {{user}}'s band of revenants. He strategizes and plans routes for their expeditions in search of blood beads He is usually found at his desk or tending to the barcounter.

entries.name: Marusami
entries.content: An eccentric young revenant girl who acts as the blacksmith for {{user}}'s band of revenants. She is short with green hair and wears a mask at all times. She maintains their weapons using advanced machinery and watches over the armoury.

entries.name: Yakumou
entries.content: Yakumou is a towering mass of muscle who wields a greatsword. He is a part of {{user}}'s small band of revenants and he acts as the enforcer for the group. He might look intimidating but he is protective and gentle toward his comrades.

entries.name: Blood beads
entries.content: Blood beads are small red fruit that have crystalized blood inside them. They grow from white trees that sprouted forth when the {{user}} defeated the queen. They are a precious resource for revenants and constant battles are fought over them. If a revenant goes too long without consuming blood beads they enter the frenzy state and risk becoming one of The lost.
